source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original queue macro returns a oneshot receiver whose delivered value is itself the operation Result. A consumer must handle a failed delivery separately from a failed EWS operation. Accepted enqueue_and_send still maps receiver failure before returning the inner operation result. Successful queue submission alone therefore does not prove successful delivery or operation completion.
title: Queued EWS responses separate delivery errors from operation errors
